infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CoalGuard requires camera access to capture evidence photos during field mine inspections.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CoalGuard requires GPS location to tag hazard locations and mine inspection coordinates.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CoalGuard requires photo library access to attach existing site evidence photos.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CoalGuard to access your camera for field hazard evidence capture.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow CoalGuard to use your location for precise geospatial hazard mapping.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow CoalGuard to access your photo library for attaching inspection evidence.
